rows.title: Scenes from a Marriage movie review review:
rows.comment: most luminous love stories ever made
rows.verdict_le10: most luminous love stories ever made
rows.dek_lead: And so begins one of the truest, most luminous love stories ever made, Ingmar Bergman’s “Scenes from a Marriage.” The marriage of Johan and Marianne will disintegrate soon after the film begins, but their love will not.

rows.title: Review: Ingmar Bergman’s Scenes from a Marriage on Criterion Blu-ray
rows.comment: Scenes from a Marriage profoundly reveals such a narrative to be absurd and undesirable.
rows.verdict_le10: Scenes from a Marriage profoundly reveals such a narrative to be absurd and undesirable.
rows.dek_lead: Countless films concern the quest for stability, which usually requires the taming of a hero’s wilder impulses. Scenes from a Marriage profoundly reveals such a narrative to be absurd and undesirable.
